source.snippet: I am trying to set up a very simple Einstein Recipe in MCP and it doesn't seem to be working when I run the test simulation. We have various articles that have 1 or more categories associated to them. I am just trying to do a test simulation so that if the Anchor page has Category = A, the recommendations show Articles that also have Category = A. I am finding when I run the simulation, this is only working for SOME categories.

problem_statement: Marketers and Salesforce admins configuring Marketing Cloud Personalization (Einstein Recipes) find that category-based article recommendations work inconsistently — only firing for some categories — with no clear debugging path or tooling to diagnose the root cause.
target_segment: Marketing operations teams and Salesforce developers at mid-market and enterprise companies using Marketing Cloud Personalization
notes: Paid enterprise context (SFMC licenses are expensive). Einstein Recipes misconfiguration is a recurring pain point for Salesforce partners. Opportunity for a diagnostic/audit tool or managed service for SFMC Personalization setup. Single signal but strong buyer profile.
